title: Cross-Sheet Invariants — 32 CSR Registry v1.0
description: Populated INSTANCE document (not a meta-schema) carrying the 32 Cross-Sheet Rules per §9.1. Top-level `rules` array is the source of truth consumed by the consistency_check tool. Per S3.5 pivot: instance documents live at `NAME.json`; if a paired meta-schema is ever needed it would go to `NAME.schema.json`. Verdict aggregation (§9.2/§17.2): any RED → RED; else any AMBER/WARN → AMBER; all PASS → GREEN. Severity-to-verdict: CRITICAL/HIGH → RED on FAIL, MEDIUM/LOW → AMBER on FAIL. P0-01 (codex audit Phase 1): the `rule` text + `severity` of every IMPLEMENTED F-ID is bound to scripts/validation/validate_invariants.py (the runtime source of truth) and locked by tests/schemas/test_cross_sheet_invariants_sync.py. Original §17.2 design meanings that the row-level validator does not yet enforce are preserved (not deleted) under the top-level `deferred_design_rules` array.
verdict_aggregation: any RED → RED; else any AMBER/WARN → AMBER; all PASS → GREEN

rules.rule: master_task.status ⊆ statusEnum {TODO,ONGOING,EXISTS,DONE,BLOCKED,DEFERRED,CANCELED}
rules.rationale: master_task.status must be one of the 7 canonical statusEnum values (ADR-018); any other token corrupts the DONE cascade and the §17.2 verdict aggregator. Enforced by validate_invariants.check_F_01.

rules.rule: dashboard sheet contains no live `=COUNTIF(...)` formulas
rules.rationale: The dashboard sheet must carry pre-computed values, never a live `=COUNTIF(...)` formula — Excel formulas re-evaluate on open and silently desync from the append-only state (rules/excel-discipline.md). Enforced by validate_invariants.check_F_02 (_check_no_excel_formula).

rules.rule: dashboard sheet contains no live `=SUMIF(...)` formulas
rules.rationale: The dashboard sheet must carry pre-computed values, never a live `=SUMIF(...)` formula (rules/excel-discipline.md). Enforced by validate_invariants.check_F_03 (_check_no_excel_formula).

rules.rule: dashboard sheet contains no live `=AVERAGEIF(...)` formulas
rules.rationale: The dashboard sheet must carry pre-computed values, never a live `=AVERAGEIF(...)` formula (rules/excel-discipline.md). severity CRITICAL — mirrors F-02/F-03, the analogous no-live-formula invariants; the helper _check_no_excel_formula returns CRITICAL for all three (this is the severity the old regex sync test could not see, P0-01). Enforced by validate_invariants.check_F_04.

rules.rule: every sheet present in workbook matches its master-excel.schema header column count
rules.rationale: Every sheet present in the workbook must match its master-excel.schema required_columns header count (header row resolved via schema authority); a mismatch signals a schema-drifted or hand-edited sheet. Enforced by validate_invariants.check_F_05. (The original design meaning — completed_work.task_id ⊆ master_task WHERE status=DONE — is preserved in deferred_design_rules.)

rules.rule: new_content_plan.url_slug ⊆ topical_map.assigned_url
rules.rationale: Content planned outside the topical map creates orphan pages with no pillar home — kills topical authority signal. Mirrored as CI-07.

rules.rule: content_improve.url ⊆ (crawl_sitemap ∩ topical_map)
rules.rationale: Improvement tasks must target pages that both exist (crawl_sitemap) AND have a pillar assignment (topical_map); otherwise the edit has no strategic context.

rules.rule: quick_wins.url ⊆ (crawl_sitemap.url ∪ gsc_performance.url)
rules.rationale: Quick-win URLs must be reachable (crawl_sitemap) or already earning impressions (gsc_performance); a URL in neither reference set is fictitious. Sparse-pilot tolerance routes to AMBER via manual_triage when both reference sheets are absent. Enforced by validate_invariants.check_F_08.

rules.rule: master_task.task_id is unique across all rows
rules.rationale: master_task.task_id must be unique across all rows; duplicate task_ids break the DONE-cascade keying and completed_work joins. Enforced by validate_invariants.check_F_09.

rules.rule: url_normalizer(x) == x for every quick_wins.url (D-03 idempotent)
rules.rationale: Every quick_wins.url must be a fixed point of the D-03 url_normalizer (idempotent); a non-idempotent URL means the normalizer was bypassed at write time (boundary violation §6.6) and breaks cross-sheet JOINs. Enforced by validate_invariants.check_F_10.

rules.rule: every _state/workflows/*.json has schema_version == "1.0"
rules.rationale: Every _state/workflows/*.json must declare schema_version == "1.0" (ADR-019 / workflow-run.schema.json const). Enforced by validate_invariants.check_F_11.

rules.rule: events.jsonl line count is monotonically non-decreasing
rules.rationale: events.jsonl line count must be monotonically non-decreasing against the _state/events.snapshot.json sidecar — a shrink means the append-only audit log was truncated (rule append-only-state §3). Enforced by validate_invariants.check_F_12.

rules.rule: every event_kind=provenance row has run_id of integer type
rules.rationale: Every event_kind=provenance row must carry a run_id of integer type (events.schema). Enforced by validate_invariants.check_F_13.

rules.rule: every event_kind=workflow row has workflow_run_id matching {slug}-YYYY-MM-DD-{hash4}
rules.rationale: Every event_kind=workflow row must carry a workflow_run_id matching {slug}-YYYY-MM-DD-{hash4} (events.schema / ADR-020). Enforced by validate_invariants.check_F_14.

rules.rule: cannibalization intent çakışması intent-matrix.json ile tutarlı (manual triage)
rules.rationale: Two pages ranking for the same query are only 'cannibalizing' when their intents overlap per intent-matrix.json — a product page + a blog post for the same query may be intentional. Requires manual triage per §9.3 (routes to AMBER, not RED). Enforced by validate_invariants.check_F_15.

rules.rule: topical_map.pillar ⊆ data/pillars.json
rules.rationale: Pillar key drift breaks every pillar-scoped report and the pillar_launch event (§20.2). Auto-repair available (JSON re-key + user confirm §9.3).

rules.rule: cluster_keywords.cluster ⊆ data/cluster defs
rules.rationale: Cluster label drift detaches keywords from their cluster definitions — downstream keyword_difficulty/priority scoring becomes meaningless.

rules.rule: url_normalizer(x) == x for every URL in every sheet
rules.rationale: Non-idempotent URLs break cross-sheet JOINs; mirrored as CI-05. Any failure means the url_normalizer was bypassed at write time (boundary violation §6.6).

rules.rule: gsc_performance URL set is consistent with dashboard KPI URL set
rules.rationale: Dashboard KPIs derived from gsc_performance must stay in sync after every mcp_feed run; drift means dashboard_refresh missed a sheet.

rules.rule: SF import run_id == Excel crawl_date (freshness)
rules.rationale: Stale SF data + fresh Excel date is a lying report. Freshness SLA is per-sheet in excel-source-manifest.json; staler-than-SLA triggers AMBER.

rules.rule: quick_wins.url ⊆ opportunity.assigned_url_action URL set
rules.rationale: Quick-win rows must point at URLs that the opportunity sheet has already triaged (canonical 'url | action' or freeform 'Optimize <url> for query X'); orphan quick_wins indicate that the opportunity intake step was skipped (Q-V1.2-OPP-COVERAGE-01 Phase B post-closeout schema-first override 17'inci uygulama).

rules.rule: every severity-typed cell ∈ severityEnum {LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH,CRITICAL}
rules.rationale: Severity-typed columns (priority/level/impact carrying $ref severityEnum in master-excel.schema.json) must hold one of the four canonical values; any other token corrupts severity-aware reporting and breaks the verdict aggregator.

rules.rule: every master_task.created_date is ISO 8601 parseable
rules.rationale: master_task.created_date (col K) must parse as ISO 8601; Excel-cached datetimes already pass, freeform strings require fromisoformat tolerance (Z → +00:00). Non-parseable cells break time-series reporting and the DONE cascade audit trail.

rules.rule: project.config.json declares language.content_locale (nested) + market (root) per schema 1.3
rules.rationale: Schema 1.3 (ADR-030 / Migration 0003) makes nested language.content_locale (BCP 47) + root market the canonical locale path; root locale and defaults.locale are forbidden via additionalProperties: false. Wave 2 fix Q-WAVE1-F19-VALIDATOR-01 collapses pre-1.3 reads onto the 1.3 path only.

rules.rule: every events.jsonl line is < 64 KiB (events_writer cap)
rules.rationale: events_writer enforces a 64 KiB per-line cap so events.jsonl stays line-stream parseable on stdlib JSON readers; lines exceeding the cap indicate a writer bypass (rule append-only-state §3) and corrupt the audit-trail replay loop.

rules.rule: every cell value < 32767 chars (Excel/openpyxl hard limit)
rules.rationale: Excel's hard cell-value limit is 32 767 characters; openpyxl raises IllegalCharacterError above this. Cells at or over the cap mean upstream prose was not summarized; downstream master.xlsx writes will fail and DURUR-3 fires.

rules.rule: _state/backups/master keeps at most 7 .xlsx backups (FIFO)
rules.rationale: transaction.py keep-7 FIFO rotation invariant; exceeding the cap means the rotation step was skipped and disk pressure accumulates. auto_repair_available=true — surplus backups can be deleted oldest-first without data loss.

rules.rule: if any project's _state/workflows/ has a completed sf-crawl-orchestrator run, mcp-tool-registry.json MUST list 'sf' under servers
rules.rationale: v1.8 Phase 4 D-SF-01/D-SF-02 cross-sheet invariant: a workspace that has produced SF MCP crawl evidence MUST have the engine's tool registry advertising the 'sf' server, otherwise downstream sf-import handoff and tooling discovery (claude mcp list cross-check) silently desync. Mirrors Q-SF-MCP-PHASE-3-CLOSURE-FOLLOWUPS-01 schema-first catch — workflow state and registry advertisement must stay aligned. severity HIGH (not CRITICAL) per Manager spec — drift produces broken provenance lineage but does not corrupt master.xlsx. v1.9 Phase 5 enhancement: dual-registry check (engine-repo primary + workspace-registry fallback when PSEO_WORKSPACE_ROOT set). Backward compat: engine-repo only deployments work unchanged.

rules.rule: .mcp.json mcpServers keys MUST equal mcp-tool-registry.json servers keys (sets comparison; ScraplingServer↔scrapling case-fold per D-SF-02 alignment)
rules.rationale: v1.9 Phase 2 D-V1.9-02 cross-sheet invariant — detects drift between .mcp.json transport config + mcp-tool-registry.json tool inventory. Orphan transport (.mcp.json server missing from registry) OR orphan inventory (registry server missing from .mcp.json) → FAIL. ScraplingServer (capital) in .mcp.json normalizes to scrapling (lowercase) in registry per D-SF-02 naming.md alignment. Category csr_mcp mirrors F-23 (the analogous .mcp.json↔registry MCP invariant): spec FE-1 proposed 'engine_consistency' but that value is NOT in consistency-report.schema.json's 8-category enum, so check_F_24 emits csr_mcp to keep the JSON registry aligned with the code's report category — see Q-V1.9-PHASE-2-WORKER-01.

rules.rule: if project.config.sf.mcp.enabled=true, project.config.schema_version MUST be >= '1.5' (Migration 0005 prerequisite)
rules.rationale: v1.9 Phase 3 D-V1.9-10 — defensive check enforcing schema version coherence. Migration 0005 (v1.4→v1.5) adds sf block; enabled=true on v1.4 is impossible per Migration 0005 lock but defensive check catches manual misconfiguration. Category csr_mcp (mirrors F-23/F-24, the analogous MCP invariants): the consistency-report.schema.json 8-category enum has no SF-specific bucket, so check_F_25 emits csr_mcp. Version comparison is integer-tuple (split on '.'), NOT lexicographic — correct past '1.10' (D-V1.9-10).

rules.rule: if a project's _state/workflows/ has a paused/failed sf-crawl-orchestrator run whose crawl_id still reports IN_PROGRESS via sf_crawl_progress, surface AMBER (workflow state vs SF GUI disagree)
rules.rationale: v1.9 Phase 4 D-V1.9-11 — operator-level cleanup hint NOT blocking (AMBER not RED per spec v2.2 line 210). Optional MCP-aware check runs only when sf MCP responding within 1s health probe. SKIP if MCP unreachable (avoid blocking drift-check on MCP downtime). FIRST MEDIUM-severity v1.9 invariant (F-24/F-25 are HIGH). Category csr_mcp (mirrors F-23/F-24/F-25): the consistency-report.schema.json 8-category enum has no SF-specific bucket and spec FE-3's 'mcp_runtime' is narrative only (not in the closed enum), so check_F_26 emits csr_mcp.

rules.rule: every OUTWARD MCP tool a skill declares in mcp_tools (required|optional) MUST be covered by an outward_action_gate matcher (the gate's gated-MCP set); an ungated declared outward MCP tool is a hole in the consent wall
rules.rationale: AMO batch 3-gov-driftF (spec §7-2b) — the batch-2b outward_action_gate DENIES an outward MCP submission without per-session consent, but its only gated MCP tool is mcp__gsc__submit_sitemap (the _MCP_SUBMIT_TOOL constant). If a skill later declares a NEW outward MCP tool (a future Indexing-API URL_UPDATED submit, a publish tool, …) WITHOUT a matching gate matcher, that outward action ships UNGATED — a silent hole in the consent wall (Süleyman's Indexing hard-constraint). Engine-self-governance rule mirroring F-24's sets-comparison shape: it IMPORTS the gate constant (no drift) and reuses batch 3a's declared_tools parser to enumerate every skill's declared MCP tools, then asserts declared-outward ⊆ gate matchers. A declared CURATED-outward tool the gate forgot → FAIL HIGH (RED); a declared tool that merely looks outward but is unclassified (the _OUTWARD_VERB_RE tripwire, read-verb excluded for zero false-positives) → FAIL MEDIUM (AMBER per §17.2). Category csr_mcp (mirrors F-23/F-24/F-25/F-26): the engine-governance MCP bucket.

deferred_design_rules.note: cross-sheet join rule; not yet enforced at validate_invariants row level — consistency_check tool scope. The active F-01 entry in `rules` carries the implemented meaning (status enum).

deferred_design_rules.rationale: Quick wins must be either reachable (in sitemap) or already getting impressions (GSC). A URL in neither set is fictitious.
deferred_design_rules.note: cross-sheet join rule; not yet enforced at validate_invariants row level — consistency_check tool scope. The active F-08 entry in `rules` carries the implemented meaning (quick_wins.url, not target_url).

deferred_design_rules.note: cross-sheet join rule; not yet enforced at validate_invariants row level — consistency_check tool scope. The active F-10 entry in `rules` carries the implemented meaning (quick_wins.url D-03 idempotency).

deferred_design_rules.rationale: Schema audit rows for unknown URLs indicate a sitemap/crawl drift that must be resolved before schema fixes are applied.
deferred_design_rules.note: cross-sheet join rule; not yet enforced at validate_invariants row level — consistency_check tool scope. The active F-11 entry in `rules` carries the implemented meaning (workflow-run schema_version).

deferred_design_rules.note: cross-sheet join rule; not yet enforced at validate_invariants row level — consistency_check tool scope. The active F-12 entry in `rules` carries the implemented meaning (events.jsonl monotonic line count).

deferred_design_rules.note: cross-sheet join rule; not yet enforced at validate_invariants row level — consistency_check tool scope. The active F-13 entry in `rules` carries the implemented meaning (provenance run_id integer type).
